messages:
maya: Quick sync — continuous batching rollout timeline and ownership. Milestone: Q3 sprint end deliverable = stable continuous-batching on 2 model classes + KV prefetch enabled by default for dedicated. Who owns the rollout plan and the rollback hooks?

andrew: I can take rollout plan + config PRs. Working with infra on node pressure metrics.

sam: I'll own KV-prefetch runtime changes and the handshake fallback. Need a code review on my last commit (PR #8423).

li: I'll do the canary/traffic split for dedicated clusters and set up the alerting. Can we agree on the canary sizing? 5% traffic for 24h then 25% for 6h?

maya: Sounds good. Plan outline:
- canary 5% x 24h -> evaluate p95 & OOM rates
- ramp 25% x 6h -> if stable, 100% after manual thumbs up
- automatic rollback on >20% latency regression or >3 OOMs/host in 1h

andrew: FYI infra requested a flag to force-disable prefetch at runtime: `--kv-prefetch=false`. I'll include that in the PR.

sam: tagging the PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8423 :eyes:

sam: small snippet of the config I'm testing locally:

```yaml
batching:
  continuous: true
  max_batch_size: 96
  max_wait_ms: 12
  dynamic_window: true
kv_cache:
  prefetch: true
  prefetch_window_ms: 50
  handshake_retry: 2
```

andrew: quick perf numbers from local perf harness (same model family used in canary):
- baseline (no continuous batching): p50=8ms p95=32ms tokens/s=2100
- cont-batching v1: p50=6ms p95=18ms tokens/s=2900
- with kv-prefetch: p95 down to 14ms, cold starts improved by ~40%

li: Those look promising. Ops visibility checklist:
- expose `kernel.batch.window_ms` as metric
- trace id propagation for batch composition
- host OOM / mem pressure dashboards updated

maya: Assignment recap:
- andrew: rollout config PR + disable flag + rollback hooks
- sam: runtime KV-prefetch changes + PR review address comments
- li: canary sizing, prometheus dashboards, alert thresholds
- maya: coordinate RFC + stakeholder comms (support, sales, docs)

li: minor dependency: config schema bump to v1.12. That touches router and console. @andrew can you coordinate with console on parsing the new keys?

andrew: yep I'll ping console team, will add a note in the PR description.

sam: code-review ping: @andrew @li can you look at the handshake retry logic? it's the main risk for noise during rollout.

andrew: will review today.

ops-bot: [infra] New canary cluster created: cluster-cont-batch-canary-03 (zone us-west-2b). Ticket #INF-1129

maya: Good. One more: can we define an explicit rollback runbook? Short steps so oncall can act fast.

li: draft runbook:
1) `kubectl scale deployment runtime --replicas=0` for affected pool
2) set `--kv-prefetch=false` via feature toggle in configstore
3) revert the latest canary host set to previous instance group
4) alert #incidents and ops oncall

sam: adding an automated rollback hook in the orchestrator would be great (trigger on OOM rate). I'll file a small task.

andrew: FYI there's a minor ABI change in kernel patch; runtime teams need to pin compiled kernels for dedicated. I'll send a compatibility matrix to eng-infra.

maya: Thanks all. If no blockers, I'll schedule the canary for tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Please ack and share any last-minute blocking PRs. :thumbsup:

li: ack

andrew: ack, PRs incoming in the next 2 hours

sam: ack, will squash and address comments by EOD

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary rollout start=1768872000, owner=andrew. Notifications enabled.

maya: Great — closing thread for async followups. Post any surprises in #eng-runtime or tag me directly.
